sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: The Lab is a location in Escape from Tarkov. It is the sixth map that was added to the game.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: Secret underground TerraGroup Labs facility hidden right under the center of Tarkov. Officially, this research center does not exist and, based on data scraps, is engaged in research and development as well as testing and simulation of projects in chemistry, physics, biology, and other high technology.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
- The Lab is initially only accessible by transiting. Direct access from the location selection screen is unlocked upon progressing through the story chapter Tour.
- This location can only be entered with a TerraGroup Labs access keycard.

sections.heading: Insurance
sections.text: All insured items left in a raid by players will not be returned. Upon death, insurance Traders will send the usual in-game mail about dispatching people to recover the items, but when the insurance timer runs out they will explain that their people don't go to the location, didn't find it or died in the process.

sections.heading: Illumination
sections.text: The illumination can be disabled by turning off the power in the basement.

sections.heading: Announcer
sections.text:
Whenever an event of high importance happens, an announcement will be triggered. There is an announcement for every extraction activation besides "Ventilation Shaft" and "Sewage Conduit".

The announcement for the "Parking Gate" extraction can be disabled inside the alarm system control panel room. A Yellow keycard is needed to enter it.

sections.heading: Bosses
sections.text: Seasonal change: Scav Raiders are replaced by Black Division.

sections.heading: Extractions
sections.text:
Note: Upon activating any of the extraction switches, there is a chance for Scav Raiders to spawn and roam towards the activation location.
To locate the extractions use the maps below the table.
| Name | Always available | Single-Use | Requirements | Notes | Announcement |
| Cargo Elevator | yes | yes | Restore power in the basement, room G1. | Second floor, opposite of room G21. | Sector G |
| Hangar Gate | no | no | Open the gate in cabin B24, on the second floor of the hangar. | Sector B11. | Sector B11 |
| Main Elevator | yes | no | Restore power in the basement, opposite of room R4. | In the basement, in the corridor between the rooms R6 and R8. | Sector R |
| Medical Block Elevator | yes | no | Restore power in the basement, room G6. | In the basement between the rooms G3 and G4. | Sector O |
| Parking Gate | no | no | Open the gate in room Y21 on the second floor, next to R22. | Sector Y11. | Sector Y11 |
| Sewage Conduit | yes | no | Sink the water level. | Room B1 in the basement.; The switch to sink the water is on the left, the extraction on the right side of the room.; The water takes ~80 seconds to sink. | - |
| Ventilation Shaft | yes | no | No backpack equipped. | In the basement, corridor between the rooms G1 and G8, next to G7. | - |
